findings: Competition verify_ns grouped StoreReader initialization, store digest/index validation, helper initialization, object decode/CID validation, semantic verify_store and function lookup. It was not a pure graph-check timer.
xax_native.native_host admits only Linux x86-64. Windows authority records Python fallbacks for hash, store/graph decoders, typing, CFG and store verifier.

blake3._native_compressor loads/verifies/lowers its canonical compression helper before NativeBlake3Compressor reaches mmap.PROT_EXEC availability rejection on Windows; the cold cost includes an unusable helper attempt.

Checked byte-view accesses in _verify_memory_node reconstruct bits_type(8*size).cid at xax_compiler.py:5427. cProfile shows 1492 calls through this caller for nested_math, in addition to helper initialization calls.

Explicit verify_store followed by compile_native_bound_target or compile_android_shared causes a second verify_store on the same immutable reader. Existing ProofCache can reuse exact local verdicts without skipping first verification or changing graph/native output.
Parsed graph CID cache already exists in _PARSED_GRAPHS and checks dependencies on reuse; proposing a new general graph parse cache would duplicate existing machinery.
